answer: Vesting with clawback makes a fake wait for pay while audits hunt it. Each 40 POA epoch reward vests over 8 epochs, and every epoch 10% of keys face a duplicate-controller audit, so a fake survives all 8 with chance 0.9^8 = 43%. The canyon is the unvested balance an audit forfeits, 40 POA at payout and a nadir of 5 POA at epoch 7; a gale rule triples sampling to 30% when an epoch's flags double. 1,000 fakes x 40 POA x 57% caught = 22,800 POA. Attacker pays 22,800 POA.
